analyzed_vuln.description: Use-of-uninitialized-value originates from ParseRGroupLabels replacing an atom with a stack-allocated QueryAtom copy (`mol->replaceAtom(atIdx, &qatom)`) while existing atom bookmarks/SGroup references are later used. In this PoV, SGroup SAL parsing (`addAtomWithBookmark`) reads an atom index from a bookmark that became invalid/stale after replaceAtom (old atom deleted), propagating uninitialized atom indices into SubstanceGroup atom lists. Later, processMrvImplicitH iterates those SGroup atom indices and triggers MSan on the uninitialized value.
analyzed_vuln.conditions: Trigger requires a mol block that (1) sets R-group labels (`M  RGP`) on atoms that are also referenced by SGroup vector data (`M  SAL`), and (2) defines a DAT SGroup with FIELDNAME `MRV_IMPLICIT_H`/datafield `IMPL_H...` so post-processing walks SGroup atom indices. Data flow: harness calls MolDataStreamToMol -> ParseV2000CTAB -> ParseMolBlockProperties; `M  RGP` causes ParseRGroupLabels/replaceAtom, then `M  SAL` uses bookmark lookup for SGroup atoms, storing tainted/uninitialized indices; finishMolProcessing -> ProcessMolProps -> processSGroups -> processMrvImplicitH consumes those indices, producing MSan uninitialized-use.
